budget_items.topic: City of Fitchburg street light purchase from Unitil
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg bought 3080 street lights from Unitil for a stated total, about $17 per light, before converting them to LED.
budget_items.quote: at a cost of $300,000, ($17 per light) in order to convert to led.

budget_items.topic: City of Fitchburg LED conversion cost and rebate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg spent a stated amount converting the lights to LED, including networking, and received a rebate from Unitil.
budget_items.quote: $1,000,000 was spent to convert the lights to led, including networking the lights. a $275,000 rebate was awarded by unitil.

budget_items.topic: Fitchburg annual street light cost per light
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Annual cost per light fell from a stated amount under Unitil ownership, to a lower amount under City ownership, to a lowest amount after LED conversion.
budget_items.quote: the annual costs went from $157 per light when unitil owned, to $90 when the city owned them, to $35 after led conversion.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg has 333 street lights with an annual cost of $122 per light; the FY 18 budget projects $129 per light.
budget_items.quote: with annual costs of $122 per light. our fy 18 budget projects a cost of $129 per light.

budget_items.topic: Cost to purchase Lunenburg street lights from Unitil
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Purchasing the street lights is likely to cost about one year's lighting bill; net metering credits were suggested as the payment source.
budget_items.quote: it is likely to cost the equivalent of one years lighting bill to purchase the lights.
